info.name: Golden Wing Warlock
info.description: Drahon’s Essence is an Otherworldly Patron option for the warlock, born from the surviving essence of the dead god-dragon Drahon the Golden.

description.p: Drahon the Golden is dead, but a god-dragon does not vanish as mortals do. Fragments of his sacred essence still cling to souls, relics, dragons, and the wounded land of Edrassia. A rare few are chosen by that essence. They dream of vast golden wings spread across a darkened sky, awaken with light beneath their skin, and hear a distant heartbeat whenever innocent blood is spilled.

A Golden Wing Warlock does not bargain with Drahon himself. Instead, the Warlock carries a living fragment of his final purpose: life, light, protection, courage, and restoration. This fragment takes the form of a golden draconic spirit called a Golden Herald. As the Warlock’s bond grows, the spirit and bearer become increasingly difficult to separate.
Some Golden Wings see themselves as Drahon’s heirs. Others fear that every use of his power consumes another piece of what remains of him.

sheet.description: A Golden Wing Warlock carries a living fragment of the dead god-dragon Drahon: a golden draconic spirit called a Golden Herald.

description.p: Drahon’s Essence lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a warlock spell. The following spells are added to the warlock spell list for you.

sheet.description: Drahon’s Essence lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a warlock spell.

description.p: When you choose this patron at 1st level, a fragment of Drahon’s Essence takes physical form and binds itself to you. This spirit is your Golden Herald, a Tiny celestial creature resembling a golden-winged drake, bird, or other small creature of your choice. It is friendly to you and your companions and obeys your commands.

While the Herald is perched on you, it shares your space, cannot be targeted, cannot take damage, and cannot take actions or reactions. It can mount or leave your shoulder using 5 feet of its movement.
While the Herald is within 100 feet of you, you can communicate with it telepathically.
While the Herald is perched on you, you gain the following benefits:

ul.li: You gain darkvision out to 60 feet. If you already have darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet.
You add your Charisma modifier to Wisdom (Perception) checks and to your passive Wisdom (Perception) score.
You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

sheet.description: While your Golden Herald is perched on you, you gain darkvision out to 60 feet (or +30 feet if you already have darkvision), you add your Charisma modifier to Wisdom (Perception) checks and to your passive Wisdom (Perception) score, and you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

description.p: Starting at 6th level, Drahon’s Essence moves to place you between destruction and its victim. When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to manifest spectral golden wings around that creature. Reduce the damage by 1d10 + your Charisma modifier + your warlock level.
After the damage is reduced, the protected creature can move up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. This movement doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

sheet.description: When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can manifest spectral golden wings around that creature, reducing the damage by 1d10 + your Charisma modifier + your warlock level. The protected creature can then move up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space it can see without provoking opportunity attacks.

description.p: Also at 6th level, while your Golden Herald is perched on you, you can use a bonus action to merge with it and assume the Aspect of the Golden Wing. The transformation lasts for 10 minutes, until you end it as a bonus action, or until you are incapacitated. While transformed:

ul.li: You manifest spectral wings and gain a flying speed of 40 feet.
You can pass through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
You cannot cast spells, make attacks, or force another creature to make a saving throw.

description.p: Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

sheet.description: While your Golden Herald is perched on you, you can merge with it for 10 minutes, until you end it as a bonus action, or until you are incapacitated. While transformed, you gain a flying speed of 40 feet and can pass through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing, but you cannot cast spells, make attacks, or force another creature to make a saving throw.

description.p: Starting at 10th level, the remnant within you refuses to allow Drahon’s light to be extinguished again. You gain resistance to necrotic and radiant damage, and you have advantage on death saving throws.

sheet.description: You gain resistance to necrotic and radiant damage, and you have advantage on death saving throws.

description.p: Starting at 14th level, you can briefly awaken the full power of Drahon’s Essence. As a bonus action, you enter the Living Legacy state for 1 minute. When you transform, choose any number of creatures you can see within 30 feet of you. Each chosen creature regains hit points equal to 2d8 + your Charisma modifier, and you can end either the charmed or frightened condition on it.
For the duration, you gain the following benefits:

ul.li: Two immense golden wings appear from your back. You gain a flying speed of 60 feet and can hover.
You shed bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.
Once on each of your turns when you deal damage to a creature, you can deal an additional 2d8 radiant damage to that creature.

When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to grant it resistance to that instance of damage. If you do, the Living Legacy state ends at the end of the current turn.

description.p: Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
